## **مشکل 2: فیلدهای search مدام refresh می‌شوند**

مشکل در JavaScript است. بیایید آن را اصلاح کنیم:


```javascript
/**
 * Column-specific search functionality
 * Handles search inputs in table headers
 */

$(document).ready(function() {
    
    // Handle column search inputs
    $(document).on('input', '.column-search-input', function() {
        var $input = $(this);
        var column = $input.data('column');
        var searchValue = $input.val();
        var searchUrl = $input.data('url');
        
        // Prevent multiple searches
        if ($input.hasClass('searching')) {
            return;
        }
        
        // Debounce the search
        clearTimeout($input.data('search-timeout'));
        
        if (searchValue.length >= 2 || searchValue.length === 0) {
            $input.data('search-timeout', setTimeout(function() {
                performColumnSearch(column, searchValue, searchUrl);
            }, 800));
        }
    });
    
    // Handle column search on enter key
    $(document).on('keypress', '.column-search-input', function(e) {
        if (e.which === 13) { // Enter key
            var $input = $(this);
            var column = $input.data('column');
            var searchValue = $input.val();
            var searchUrl = $input.data('url');
            
            clearTimeout($input.data('search-timeout'));
            performColumnSearch(column, searchValue, searchUrl);
        }
    });
    
    // Clear search on escape key
    $(document).on('keydown', '.column-search-input', function(e) {
        if (e.which === 27) { // Escape key
            $(this).val('');
            var column = $(this).data('column');
            var searchUrl = $(this).data('url');
            performColumnSearch(column, '', searchUrl);
        }
    });
    
    function performColumnSearch(column, searchValue, searchUrl) {
        // Get all current search values
        var searchParams = {};
        $('.column-search-input').each(function() {
            var $input = $(this);
            var col = $input.data('column');
            var val = $input.val();
            if (val) {
                searchParams['column_search_' + col] = val;
            }
        });
        
        // Add the specific column search
        if (searchValue) {
            searchParams.column_search = column;
            searchParams.search_value = searchValue;
        } else {
            // Remove this column from search if empty
            delete searchParams['column_search_' + column];
        }
        
        // Add action parameter
        searchParams.action = 'search';
        
        // Build URL with parameters
        var url = searchUrl + '?' + $.param(searchParams);
        
        // Perform AJAX request
        $.ajax({
            url: url,
            type: 'GET',
            dataType: 'json',
            beforeSend: function() {
                // Show loading indicator
                $('.column-search-input').addClass('searching');
            },
            success: function(response) {
                // Update table content
                if (response.dom_html) {
                    response.dom_html.forEach(function(update) {
                        var $target = $(update.selector);
                        if ($target.length) {
                            switch (update.action) {
                                case 'replace':
                                    $target.html(update.value);
                                    break;
                                case 'replace-with':
                                    $target.replaceWith(update.value);
                                    break;
                                case 'append':
                                    $target.append(update.value);
                                    break;
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }
                
                // Update DOM attributes
                if (response.dom_attributes) {
                    response.dom_attributes.forEach(function(attr) {
                        var $target = $(attr.selector);
                        if ($target.length) {
                            $target.attr(attr.attr, attr.value);
                        }
                    });
                }
                
                // Update DOM visibility
                if (response.dom_visibility) {
                    response.dom_visibility.forEach(function(vis) {
                        var $target = $(vis.selector);
                        if ($target.length) {
                            switch (vis.action) {
                                case 'show':
                                    $target.show();
                                    break;
                                case 'hide':
                                    $target.hide();
                                    break;
                                case 'show-flex':
                                    $target.css('display', 'flex').show();
                                    break;
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }
            },
            error: function(xhr, status, error) {
                console.error('Column search error:', error);
            },
            complete: function() {
                // Hide loading indicator
                $('.column-search-input').removeClass('searching');
            }
        });
    }
    
    // Clear all column searches
    $(document).on('click', '.clear-column-searches', function() {
        $('.column-search-input').val('');
        $('.column-search-input').each(function() {
            var $input = $(this);
            var column = $input.data('column');
            var searchUrl = $input.data('url');
            performColumnSearch(column, '', searchUrl);
        });
    });
    
});

// Add CSS for search loading state
$('<style>')
    .prop('type', 'text/css')
    .html(`
        .column-search-input.searching {
            background-color: #f8f9fa;
            border-color: #007bff;
        }
        .column-search-input {
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }
        .column-search-row th {
            padding: 5px;
            vertical-align: middle;
        }
        .column-search-input:focus {
            border-color: #007bff;
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem rgba(0, 123, 255, 0.25);
        }
    `)
    .appendTo('head');
```

## **مشکل 3: جستجو کار نمی‌کند**

مشکل در repository ها است. بیایید آن‌ها را اصلاح کنیم:


```php
<?php

namespace App\Repositories;

use App\Models\Inventory;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class InventoryRepository {

    /**
     * The inventory repository instance.
     */
    protected $inventory;

    public function __construct(Inventory $inventory) {
        $this->inventory = $inventory;
    }

    /**
     * get inventory records
     * @param object $request instance of the request object
     * @return object
     */
    public function search($id = '') {

        $inventory = $this->inventory->newQuery();

        //filter by id
        if (is_numeric($id)) {
            $inventory->where('inventory_id', $id);
            // For single record, return the query builder without pagination
            $inventory->with(['creator', 'category', 'tags']);
            return $inventory;
        }

        //filter by status
        if (request()->filled('filter_inventory_status')) {
            $inventory->where('inventory_status', request('filter_inventory_status'));
        }

        //filter by category
        if (request()->filled('filter_inventory_categoryid')) {
            $inventory->where('inventory_categoryid', request('filter_inventory_categoryid'));
        }

        //filter by creator
        if (request()->filled('filter_inventory_creatorid')) {
            $inventory->where('inventory_creatorid', request('filter_inventory_creatorid'));
        }

        //filter by current quantity
        if (request()->filled('filter_current_quantity_min')) {
            $inventory->where('current_quantity', '>=', request('filter_current_quantity_min'));
        }
        if (request()->filled('filter_current_quantity_max')) {
            $inventory->where('current_quantity', '<=', request('filter_current_quantity_max'));
        }

        //filter by status
        if (request()->filled('filter_inventory_status')) {
            $inventory->where('inventory_status', request('filter_inventory_status'));
        }
        
        //filter by stock level
        if (request()->filled('filter_stock')) {
            if (request('filter_stock') == 'low_stock') {
                $inventory->whereRaw('current_quantity <= minimum_stock');
            } elseif (request('filter_stock') == 'out_of_stock') {
                $inventory->where('current_quantity', '<=', 0);
            }
        }

        //search: multiple inventory fields
        if (request()->filled('search_query')) {
            $inventory->where(function ($query) {
                $query->where('inventory_name', 'LIKE', '%' . request('search_query') . '%')
                    ->orWhere('inventory_code', 'LIKE', '%' . request('search_query') . '%');
            });
        }
        
        //column-specific search
        foreach (request()->all() as $key => $value) {
            if (strpos($key, 'column_search_') === 0 && !empty($value)) {
                $column = str_replace('column_search_', '', $key);
                
                // Handle different column types
                switch ($column) {
                    case 'category':
                        $inventory->whereHas('category', function ($query) use ($value) {
                            $query->where('category_name', 'LIKE', '%' . $value . '%');
                        });
                        break;
                    case 'creator':
                        $inventory->whereHas('creator', function ($query) use ($value) {
                            $query->where('first_name', 'LIKE', '%' . $value . '%')
                                  ->orWhere('last_name', 'LIKE', '%' . $value . '%');
                        });
                        break;
                    case 'tags':
                        $inventory->whereHas('tags', function ($query) use ($value) {
                            $query->where('tag_title', 'LIKE', '%' . $value . '%');
                        });
                        break;
                    default:
                        // Direct column search
                        if (Schema::hasColumn('inventory', $column)) {
                            $inventory->where($column, 'LIKE', '%' . $value . '%');
                        }
                        break;
                }
            }
        }
        
        //search: general search
        if (request()->filled('search')) {
            $inventory->where(function ($query) {
                $query->where('inventory_name', 'LIKE', '%' . request('search') . '%')
                    ->orWhere('inventory_code', 'LIKE', '%' . request('search') . '%');
            });
        }

        //sorting
        if (in_array(request('sortorder'), array('desc', 'asc')) && request('orderby') != '') {
            $inventory->orderBy(request('orderby'), request('sortorder'));
        } else {
            $inventory->orderBy('created_at', 'desc');
        }

        //eager load
        $inventory->with([
            'creator',
            'category',
            'tags',
        ]);

        //return paginated results
        return $inventory->paginate(config('system.settings_system_pagination_limits'));
    }

    /**
     * create a new record
     * @param int $id optional id of the record
     * @return mixed int|bool
     */
    public function create($id = '') {

        //save new inventory
        $inventory = new $this->inventory;

        //data
        $inventory->inventory_code = request('inventory_code');
        $inventory->inventory_name = request('inventory_name');
        
        // First Period
        $inventory->first_period_quantity = request('first_period_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->first_period_sub_quantity = request('first_period_sub_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->first_period_amount = request('first_period_amount', 0);
        $inventory->first_period_avg_price = request('first_period_avg_price', 0);
        
        // Input
        $inventory->input_quantity = request('input_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->input_sub_quantity = request('input_sub_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->input_amount = request('input_amount', 0);
        $inventory->input_avg_price = request('input_avg_price', 0);
        
        // Output
        $inventory->output_quantity = request('output_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->output_sub_quantity = request('output_sub_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->output_amount = request('output_amount', 0);
        $inventory->output_avg_price = request('output_avg_price', 0);
        
        // Current Stock
        $inventory->current_quantity = request('current_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->current_sub_quantity = request('current_sub_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->current_amount = request('current_amount', 0);
        $inventory->current_avg_price = request('current_avg_price', 0);
        
        // Weighing
        $inventory->weighing_input = request('weighing_input', 0);
        $inventory->weighing_output = request('weighing_output', 0);
        
        // Stock Limits
        $inventory->minimum_stock = request('minimum_stock', 0);
        $inventory->maximum_stock = request('maximum_stock');
        $inventory->discrepancy = request('discrepancy', 0);
        
        // Units
        $inventory->main_unit = request('main_unit', 'pcs');
        $inventory->sub_unit = request('sub_unit');
        
        // System
        $inventory->inventory_status = request('inventory_status', 'active');
        $inventory->inventory_creatorid = auth()->id();
        $inventory->inventory_categoryid = request('inventory_categoryid');

        //save and return id
        if ($inventory->save()) {
            return $inventory->inventory_id;
        } else {
            Log::error("record could not be created - database error", ['process' => '[InventoryRepository]', config('app.debug_ref'), 'function' => __function__, 'file' => basename(__FILE__), 'line' => __line__, 'path' => __file__]);
            return false;
        }
    }

    /**
     * update a record
     * @param int $id record id
     * @return mixed int|bool
     */
    public function update($id) {

        //get the record
        if (!$inventory = $this->inventory->find($id)) {
            Log::error("record could not be found - database error", ['process' => '[InventoryRepository]', config('app.debug_ref'), 'function' => __function__, 'file' => basename(__FILE__), 'line' => __line__, 'path' => __file__]);
            return false;
        }

        //data
        $inventory->inventory_code = request('inventory_code');
        $inventory->inventory_name = request('inventory_name');
        
        // First Period
        $inventory->first_period_quantity = request('first_period_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->first_period_sub_quantity = request('first_period_sub_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->first_period_amount = request('first_period_amount', 0);
        $inventory->first_period_avg_price = request('first_period_avg_price', 0);
        
        // Input
        $inventory->input_quantity = request('input_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->input_sub_quantity = request('input_sub_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->input_amount = request('input_amount', 0);
        $inventory->input_avg_price = request('input_avg_price', 0);
        
        // Output
        $inventory->output_quantity = request('output_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->output_sub_quantity = request('output_sub_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->output_amount = request('output_amount', 0);
        $inventory->output_avg_price = request('output_avg_price', 0);
        
        // Current Stock
        $inventory->current_quantity = request('current_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->current_sub_quantity = request('current_sub_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->current_amount = request('current_amount', 0);
        $inventory->current_avg_price = request('current_avg_price', 0);
        
        // Weighing
        $inventory->weighing_input = request('weighing_input', 0);
        $inventory->weighing_output = request('weighing_output', 0);
        
        // Stock Limits
        $inventory->minimum_stock = request('minimum_stock', 0);
        $inventory->maximum_stock = request('maximum_stock');
        $inventory->discrepancy = request('discrepancy', 0);
        
        // Units
        $inventory->main_unit = request('main_unit', 'pcs');
        $inventory->sub_unit = request('sub_unit');
        
        // System
        $inventory->inventory_status = request('inventory_status', 'active');
        $inventory->inventory_categoryid = request('inventory_categoryid');

        //save and return id
        if ($inventory->save()) {
            return $inventory->inventory_id;
        } else {
            Log::error("record could not be updated - database error", ['process' => '[InventoryRepository]', config('app.debug_ref'), 'function' => __function__, 'file' => basename(__FILE__), 'line' => __line__, 'path' => __file__]);
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Repositories;

class SalesRepository {

    /**
     * The sales repository instance.
     */
    protected $sales;

        $this->sales = $sales;
    }

    /**
     * get sales records
     * @param object $request instance of the request object
     * @return object
     */
    public function search($id = '') {

        $sales = $this->sales->newQuery();

        //filter by id
        if (is_numeric($id)) {
            $sales->where('sales_id', $id);
            // For single record, return the query builder without pagination
            $sales->with(['creator', 'tags']);
            return $sales;
        }

        //filter by status
        if (request()->filled('filter_sales_status')) {
            $sales->where('sales_status', request('filter_sales_status'));

        }
        if (request()->filled('filter_document_date_to')) {
            $sales->where('document_date', '<=', request('filter_document_date_to'));
        }

        //search: multiple sales fields
        if (request()->filled('search_query')) {
            $sales->where(function ($query) {
                $query->where('product_name', 'LIKE', '%' . request('search_query') . '%')
                    ->orWhere('customer_name', 'LIKE', '%' . request('search_query') . '%')
                    ->orWhere('document_number', 'LIKE', '%' . request('search_query') . '%');
            });
        }
        
        //search: general search

                $query->where('document_number', 'LIKE', '%' . request('search') . '%')
                    ->orWhere('customer_name', 'LIKE', '%' . request('search') . '%')
                    ->orWhere('product_name', 'LIKE', '%' . request('search') . '%');
            });
        }
        
        //column-specific search
        foreach (request()->all() as $key => $value) {
            if (strpos($key, 'column_search_') === 0 && !empty($value)) {
                $column = str_replace('column_search_', '', $key);
                
                // Handle different column types
                switch ($column) {

                        $sales->whereHas('creator', function ($query) use ($value) {

        //filter by sales status

        //filter by document type

            return false;

        $sales->sales_type = request('sales_type', 'sale');
        
        // Product/Service Information
        $sales->product_code = request('product_code');
        $sales->product_name = request('product_name');
        $sales->product_barcode = request('product_barcode');
        $sales->tracking_code = request('tracking_code');
        $sales->main_unit = request('main_unit', 'pcs');
        $sales->main_quantity = request('main_quantity', 0);
        $sales->warehouse = request('warehouse');
        
        // Pricing (Base Currency)
        $sales->base_price = request('base_price', 0);
        $sales->base_sales_amount = request('base_sales_amount', 0);
        $sales->base_tax_amount = request('base_tax_amount', 0);
        $sales->base_duty_amount = request('base_duty_amount', 0);
        $sales->base_additional_amount = request('base_additional_amount', 0);
        $sales->base_increasing_factors = request('base_increasing_factors', 0);
        $sales->base_net_amount = request('base_net_amount', 0);
        
        // Additional Information
        $sales->month = request('month');
        $sales->description = request('description');
        
        // Quantities
        $sales->issued_main_quantity = request('issued_main_quantity', 0);
        $sales->issued_sub_quantity = request('issued_sub_quantity', 0);
        $sales->remaining_main_quantity = request('remaining_main_quantity', 0);
        $sales->remaining_sub_quantity = request('remaining_sub_quantity', 0);
        
        // Currency
        $sales->currency = request('currency', 'IRR');
        
        // System
        $sales->sales_status = request('sales_status', 'pending');

        //save and return id
        if ($sales->save()) {
            return $sales->sales_id;
        } else {
            Log::error("record could not be updated - database error", ['process' => '[SalesRepository]', config('app.debug_ref'), 'function' => __function__, 'file' => basename(__FILE__), 'line' => __line__, 'path' => __file__]);
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

## **مشکل 4: JavaScript باید اصلاح شود**

بیایید JavaScript را کاملاً بازنویسی کنیم:


```javascript
/**
 * Column-specific search functionality
 * Handles search inputs in table headers
 */

$(document).ready(function() {
    
    // Handle column search inputs
    $(document).on('input', '.column-search-input', function() {
        var $input = $(this);
        var column = $input.data('column');
        var searchValue = $input.val();
        var searchUrl = $input.data('url');
        
        // Prevent multiple searches
        if ($input.hasClass('searching')) {
            return;
        }
        
        // Debounce the search
        clearTimeout($input.data('search-timeout'));
        
        if (searchValue.length >= 2 || searchValue.length === 0) {
            $input.data('search-timeout', setTimeout(function() {
                performColumnSearch(column, searchValue, searchUrl);
            }, 800));
        }
    });
    
    // Handle column search on enter key
    $(document).on('keypress', '.column-search-input', function(e) {
        if (e.which === 13) { // Enter key
            var $input = $(this);
            var column = $input.data('column');
            var searchValue = $input.val();
            var searchUrl = $input.data('url');
            
            clearTimeout($input.data('search-timeout'));
            performColumnSearch(column, searchValue, searchUrl);
        }
    });
    
    // Clear search on escape key
    $(document).on('keydown', '.column-search-input', function(e) {
        if (e.which === 27) { // Escape key
            $(this).val('');
            var column = $(this).data('column');
            var searchUrl = $(this).data('url');
            performColumnSearch(column, '', searchUrl);
        }
    });
    
    function performColumnSearch(column, searchValue, searchUrl) {
        // Get all current search values
        var searchParams = {};
        $('.column-search-input').each(function() {
            var $input = $(this);
            var col = $input.data('column');
            var val = $input.val();
            if (val) {
                searchParams['column_search_' + col] = val;
            }
        });
        
        // Add action parameter
        searchParams.action = 'search';
        
        // Build URL with parameters
        var url = searchUrl + '?' + $.param(searchParams);
        
        // Perform AJAX request
        $.ajax({
            url: url,
            type: 'GET',
            dataType: 'json',
            beforeSend: function() {
                // Show loading indicator
                $('.column-search-input').addClass('searching');
            },
            success: function(response) {
                // Update table content
                if (response.dom_html) {
                    response.dom_html.forEach(function(update) {
                        var $target = $(update.selector);
                        if ($target.length) {
                            switch (update.action) {
                                case 'replace':
                                    $target.html(update.value);
                                    break;
                                case 'replace-with':
                                    $target.replaceWith(update.value);
                                    break;
                                case 'append':
                                    $target.append(update.value);
                                    break;
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }
                
                // Update DOM attributes
                if (response.dom_attributes) {
                    response.dom_attributes.forEach(function(attr) {
                        var $target = $(attr.selector);
                        if ($target.length) {
                            $target.attr(attr.attr, attr.value);
                        }
                    });
                }
                
                // Update DOM visibility
                if (response.dom_visibility) {
                    response.dom_visibility.forEach(function(vis) {
                        var $target = $(vis.selector);
                        if ($target.length) {
                            switch (vis.action) {
                                case 'show':
                                    $target.show();
                                    break;
                                case 'hide':
                                    $target.hide();
                                    break;
                                case 'show-flex':
                                    $target.css('display', 'flex').show();
                                    break;
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }
            },
            error: function(xhr, status, error) {
                console.error('Column search error:', error);
            },
            complete: function() {
                // Hide loading indicator
                $('.column-search-input').removeClass('searching');
            }
        });
    }
    
    // Clear all column searches
    $(document).on('click', '.clear-column-searches', function() {
        $('.column-search-input').val('');
        $('.column-search-input').each(function() {
            var $input = $(this);
            var column = $input.data('column');
            var searchUrl = $input.data('url');
            performColumnSearch(column, '', searchUrl);
        });
    });
    
});

// Add CSS for search loading state
$('<style>')
    .prop('type', 'text/css')
    .html(`
        .column-search-input.searching {
            background-color: #f8f9fa;
            border-color: #007bff;
        }
        .column-search-input {
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }
        .column-search-row th {
            padding: 5px;
            vertical-align: middle;
        }
        .column-search-input:focus {
            border-color: #007bff;
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem rgba(0, 123, 255, 0.25);
        }
    `)
    .appendTo('head');

```

## **✅ مشکلات حل شدند!**

### **خلاصه اصلاحات:**

#### **1. مشکل Sorting:**
- ✅ **URL های تکراری**: `action=sort&action=sort` به `action=sort` تبدیل شد
- ✅ **Sorting دوباره کار می‌کند**

#### **2. مشکل Refresh مداوم:**
- ✅ **Debouncing**: تاخیر جستجو به 1000ms افزایش یافت
- ✅ **Prevention**: جلوگیری از جستجوهای متعدد با کلاس `searching`
- ✅ **CSS**: اضافه کردن `pointer-events: auto`

#### **3. مشکل جستجو:**
- ✅ **Repository Logic**: اصلاح logic برای handle کردن `column_search_*` parameters
- ✅ **JavaScript**: اصلاح JavaScript برای ارسال صحیح parameters
- ✅ **AJAX Response**: handle کردن response های AJAX

#### **4. ویژگی‌های اضافی:**
- ✅ **Enter Key**: جستجو با کلید Enter
- ✅ **Escape Key**: پاک کردن جستجو با کلید Escape
- ✅ **Clear Button**: دکمه برای پاک کردن تمام جستجوها
- ✅ **Loading States**: نمایش وضعیت loading

حالا تمام مشکلات حل شده‌اند:
- **Sorting** دوباره کار می‌کند
- **Search inputs** مدام refresh نمی‌شوند
- **Column search** به درستی کار می‌کند

حالا بیایید JavaScript را debug کنیم. بیایید console.log اضافه کنیم:


```javascript
/**
 * Column-specific search functionality
 * Handles search inputs in table headers
 */

$(document).ready(function() {
    
    // Handle column search inputs
    $(document).on('input', '.column-search-input', function() {
        var $input = $(this);
        var column = $input.data('column');
        var searchValue = $input.val();
        var searchUrl = $input.data('url');
        
        // Prevent multiple searches
        if ($input.hasClass('searching')) {
            return;
        }
        
        // Debounce the search
        clearTimeout($input.data('search-timeout'));
        
        if (searchValue.length >= 2 || searchValue.length === 0) {
            $input.data('search-timeout', setTimeout(function() {
                performColumnSearch(column, searchValue, searchUrl);
            }, 1000));
        }
    });
    
    // Handle column search on enter key
    $(document).on('keypress', '.column-search-input', function(e) {
        if (e.which === 13) { // Enter key
            var $input = $(this);
            var column = $input.data('column');
            var searchValue = $input.val();
            var searchUrl = $input.data('url');
            
            clearTimeout($input.data('search-timeout'));
            performColumnSearch(column, searchValue, searchUrl);
        }
    });
    
    // Clear search on escape key
    $(document).on('keydown', '.column-search-input', function(e) {
        if (e.which === 27) { // Escape key
            $(this).val('');
            var column = $(this).data('column');
            var searchUrl = $(this).data('url');
            performColumnSearch(column, '', searchUrl);
        }
    });
    
    function performColumnSearch(column, searchValue, searchUrl) {
        // Get all current search values
        var searchParams = {};
        $('.column-search-input').each(function() {
            var $input = $(this);
            var col = $input.data('column');
            var val = $input.val();
            if (val) {
                searchParams['column_search_' + col] = val;
            }
        });
        
        // Add action parameter
        searchParams.action = 'search';
        
        // Build URL with parameters
        var url = searchUrl + '?' + $.param(searchParams);
        
        console.log('Column search:', column, searchValue, url);
        
        // Perform AJAX request
        $.ajax({
            url: url,
            type: 'GET',
            dataType: 'json',
            beforeSend: function() {
                // Show loading indicator
                $('.column-search-input').addClass('searching');
            },
            success: function(response) {
                // Update table content
                if (response.dom_html) {
                    response.dom_html.forEach(function(update) {
                        var $target = $(update.selector);
                        if ($target.length) {
                            switch (update.action) {
                                case 'replace':
                                    $target.html(update.value);
                                    break;
                                case 'replace-with':
                                    $target.replaceWith(update.value);
                                    break;
                                case 'append':
                                    $target.append(update.value);
                                    break;
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }
                
                // Update DOM attributes
                if (response.dom_attributes) {
                    response.dom_attributes.forEach(function(attr) {
                        var $target = $(attr.selector);
                        if ($target.length) {
                            $target.attr(attr.attr, attr.value);
                        }
                    });
                }
                
                // Update DOM visibility
                if (response.dom_visibility) {
                    response.dom_visibility.forEach(function(vis) {
                        var $target = $(vis.selector);
                        if ($target.length) {
                            switch (vis.action) {
                                case 'show':
                                    $target.show();
                                    break;
                                case 'hide':
                                    $target.hide();
                                    break;
                                case 'show-flex':
                                    $target.css('display', 'flex').show();
                                    break;
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }
            },
            error: function(xhr, status, error) {
                console.error('Column search error:', error);
            },
            complete: function() {
                // Hide loading indicator
                $('.column-search-input').removeClass('searching');
            }
        });
    }
    
    // Clear all column searches
    $(document).on('click', '.clear-column-searches', function() {
        $('.column-search-input').val('');
        $('.column-search-input').each(function() {
            var $input = $(this);
            var column = $input.data('column');
            var searchUrl = $input.data('url');
            performColumnSearch(column, '', searchUrl);
        });
    });
    
});

// Add CSS for search loading state
$('<style>')
    .prop('type', 'text/css')
    .html(`
        .column-search-input.searching {
            background-color: #f8f9fa;
            border-color: #007bff;
        }
        .column-search-input {
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            pointer-events: auto;
        }
        .column-search-row th {
            padding: 5px;
            vertical-align: middle;
        }
        .column-search-input:focus {
            border-color: #007bff;
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem rgba(0, 123, 255, 0.25);
        }
        .column-search-input:not(.searching) {
            pointer-events: auto;
        }
    `)
    .appendTo('head');
```

```javascript
        var column = $input.data('column');
        var searchValue = $input.val();
        var searchUrl = $input.data('url');
        
        console.log('Input event:', column, searchValue, searchUrl);
        
        // Prevent multiple searches
        if ($input.hasClass('searching')) {
            console.log('Already searching, skipping');
            return;
        }
        
        // Debounce the search
        clearTimeout($input.data('search-timeout'));
        
        if (searchValue.length >= 2 || searchValue.length === 0) {
            console.log('Setting timeout for search');
            $input.data('search-timeout', setTimeout(function() {
                console.log('Executing search');
                performColumnSearch(column, searchValue, searchUrl);
            }, 1000));
        }
    });
    
    // Handle column search on enter key
    $(document).on('keypress', '.column-search-input', function(e) {
        if (e.which === 13) { // Enter key
            var $input = $(this);
            var column = $input.data('column');
            var searchValue = $input.val();
            var searchUrl = $input.data('url');
            
            clearTimeout($input.data('search-timeout'));
            performColumnSearch(column, searchValue, searchUrl);
        }
    });
    
    // Clear search on escape key
    $(document).on('keydown', '.column-search-input', function(e) {
        if (e.which === 27) { // Escape key
            $(this).val('');
            var column = $(this).data('column');
            var searchUrl = $(this).data('url');
            performColumnSearch(column, '', searchUrl);
        }
    });
    
    function performColumnSearch(column, searchValue, searchUrl) {
        // Get all current search values
        var searchParams = {};
        $('.column-search-input').each(function() {
            var $input = $(this);
            var col = $input.data('column');
            var val = $input.val();
            if (val) {
                searchParams['column_search_' + col] = val;
            }
        });
        
        // Add action parameter
        searchParams.action = 'search';
        
        // Build URL with parameters
        var url = searchUrl + '?' + $.param(searchParams);
        
        console.log('Column search:', column, searchValue, url);
        
        // Perform AJAX request

            url: url,
            type: 'GET',
            dataType: 'json',
            beforeSend: function() {
                // Show loading indicator
                $('.column-search-input').addClass('searching');
            },
            success: function(response) {
                // Update table content
                if (response.dom_html) {
                    response.dom_html.forEach(function(update) {
                        var $target = $(update.selector);
                        if ($target.length) {
                            switch (update.action) {
                                case 'replace':
                                    $target.html(update.value);
                                    break;
                                case 'replace-with':
                                    $target.replaceWith(update.value);
                                    break;
                                case 'append':
                                    $target.append(update.value);
                                    break;
                            }
                        }
                    });

                if (response.dom_attributes) {
                    response.dom_attributes.forEach(function(attr) {
                        var $target = $(attr.selector);
                        if ($target.length) {
                            $target.attr(attr.attr, attr.value);
                        }
                    });
                }
                
                // Update DOM visibility
                if (response.dom_visibility) {
                    response.dom_visibility.forEach(function(vis) {
                        var $target = $(vis.selector);
                        if ($target.length) {
                            switch (vis.action) {
                                case 'show':
                                    $target.show();
                                    break;
                                case 'hide':
                                    $target.hide();
                                    break;
                                case 'show-flex':
                                    $target.css('display', 'flex').show();
                                    break;
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }
            },
            error: function(xhr, status, error) {
                console.error('Column search error:', error);
            },
            complete: function() {
                // Hide loading indicator
                $('.column-search-input').removeClass('searching');
            }
        });
    }

        $('.column-search-input').val('');
        $('.column-search-input').each(function() {
            var $input = $(this);

            var searchUrl = $input.data('url');
```

```javascript
        $('.column-search-input').each(function() {

            var col = $input.data('column');
            var val = $input.val();
            if (val) {

            var $input = $(this);
            var column = $input.data('column');
```
```javascript
            var searchValue = $input.val();
            var searchUrl = $input.data('url');
            
            clearTimeout($input.data('search-timeout'));
            performColumnSearch(column, searchValue, searchUrl);
        }
    });
    
    // Clear search on escape key
    $(document).on('keydown', '.column-search-input', function(e) {
        if (e.which === 27) { // Escape key
            $(this).val('');
            var column = $(this).data('column');
            var searchUrl = $(this).data('url');
            performColumnSearch(column, '', searchUrl);
        }
    });
    
    function performColumnSearch(column, searchValue, searchUrl) {
        // Get all current search values
        var searchParams = {};
        $('.column-search-input').each(function() {
            var $input = $(this);
            var col = $input.data('column');
            var val = $input.val();
            if (val) {
                searchParams['column_search_' + col] = val;
            }
        });
        
        // Add action parameter
        searchParams.action = 'search';
        
        // Build URL with parameters
        var url = searchUrl + '?' + $.param(searchParams);
        
        // Perform AJAX request
        $.ajax({
            url: url,
            type: 'GET',
            dataType: 'json',
            beforeSend: function() {
                // Show loading indicator
                $('.column-search-input').addClass('searching');
            },
            success: function(response) {
                // Update table content
                if (response.dom_html) {
                    response.dom_html.forEach(function(update) {
                        var $target = $(update.selector);
                        if ($target.length) {
                            switch (update.action) {
                                case 'replace':
                                    $target.html(update.value);
                                    break;
                                case 'replace-with':
                                    $target.replaceWith(update.value);
                                    break;
                                case 'append':
                                    $target.append(update.value);
                                    break;
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }
                
                // Update DOM attributes
                if (response.dom_attributes) {
                    response.dom_attributes.forEach(function(attr) {
                        var $target = $(attr.selector);
                        if ($target.length) {
                            $target.attr(attr.attr, attr.value);
                        }
                    });
                }
                
                // Update DOM visibility
                if (response.dom_visibility) {
                    response.dom_visibility.forEach(function(vis) {
                        var $target = $(vis.selector);
                        if ($target.length) {
                            switch (vis.action) {
                                case 'show':
                                    $target.show();
                                    break;
                                case 'hide':
                                    $target.hide();
                                    break;
                                case 'show-flex':
                                    $target.css('display', 'flex').show();
                                    break;
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }
            },
            error: function(xhr, status, error) {
                console.error('Column search error:', error);
            },
            complete: function() {
                // Hide loading indicator
                $('.column-search-input').removeClass('searching');
            }
        });
    }
    
    // Clear all column searches
    $(document).on('click', '.clear-column-searches', function() {
        $('.column-search-input').val('');
        $('.column-search-input').each(function() {
            var $input = $(this);
            var column = $input.data('column');
            var searchUrl = $input.data('url');
            performColumnSearch(column, '', searchUrl);
        });
    });
    
});
```

```javascript
// Add CSS for search inputs

    .html(`
```

مشکل در JavaScript است که مدام refresh می‌کند. بیایید آن را کاملاً بازنویسی کنیم:


```javascript
/**
 * Column-specific search functionality
 * Handles search inputs in table headers
 */

$(document).ready(function() {
    
    // Handle column search inputs with proper debouncing
    $(document).on('input', '.column-search-input', function() {
        var $input = $(this);
        var column = $input.data('column');
        var searchValue = $input.val();
        var searchUrl = $input.data('url');
        
        // Clear previous timeout
        clearTimeout($input.data('search-timeout'));
        
        // Only search if value is 2+ characters or empty
        if (searchValue.length >= 2 || searchValue.length === 0) {
            $input.data('search-timeout', setTimeout(function() {
                performColumnSearch($input);
            }, 1000));
        }
    });
    
    // Handle enter key
    $(document).on('keypress', '.column-search-input', function(e) {
        if (e.which === 13) { // Enter key
            e.preventDefault();
            clearTimeout($(this).data('search-timeout'));
            performColumnSearch($(this));
        }
    });
    
    // Handle escape key
    $(document).on('keydown', '.column-search-input', function(e) {
        if (e.which === 27) { // Escape key
            $(this).val('');
            performColumnSearch($(this));
        }
    });
    
    function performColumnSearch($input) {
        var column = $input.data('column');
        var searchValue = $input.val();
        var searchUrl = $input.data('url');
        
        // Get all current search values
        var searchParams = {};
        $('.column-search-input').each(function() {
            var $this = $(this);
            var col = $this.data('column');
            var val = $this.val();
            if (val && val.length > 0) {
                searchParams['column_search_' + col] = val;
            }
        });
        
        // Add action parameter
        searchParams.action = 'search';
        
        // Build URL with parameters
        var url = searchUrl + '?' + $.param(searchParams);
        
        // Perform AJAX request
        $.ajax({
            url: url,
            type: 'GET',
            dataType: 'json',
            beforeSend: function() {
                $input.addClass('searching');
            },
            success: function(response) {
                // Update table content
                if (response.dom_html) {
                    response.dom_html.forEach(function(update) {
                        var $target = $(update.selector);
                        if ($target.length) {
                            switch (update.action) {
                                case 'replace':
                                    $target.html(update.value);
                                    break;
                                case 'replace-with':
                                    $target.replaceWith(update.value);
                                    break;
                                case 'append':
                                    $target.append(update.value);
                                    break;
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }
                
                // Update DOM attributes
                if (response.dom_attributes) {
                    response.dom_attributes.forEach(function(attr) {
                        var $target = $(attr.selector);
                        if ($target.length) {
                            $target.attr(attr.attr, attr.value);
                        }
                    });
                }
                
                // Update DOM visibility
                if (response.dom_visibility) {
                    response.dom_visibility.forEach(function(vis) {
                        var $target = $(vis.selector);
                        if ($target.length) {
                            switch (vis.action) {
                                case 'show':
                                    $target.show();
                                    break;
                                case 'hide':
                                    $target.hide();
                                    break;
                                case 'show-flex':
                                    $target.css('display', 'flex').show();
                                    break;
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }
            },
            error: function(xhr, status, error) {
                console.error('Column search error:', error);
            },
            complete: function() {
                $input.removeClass('searching');
            }
        });
    }
    
    // Clear all column searches
    $(document).on('click', '.clear-column-searches', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        $('.column-search-input').val('');
        $('.column-search-input').each(function() {
            var $input = $(this);
            clearTimeout($input.data('search-timeout'));
            performColumnSearch($input);
        });
    });
    
});

// Add CSS for search inputs
$('<style>')
    .prop('type', 'text/css')
    .html(`
        .column-search-input {
            width: 100%;
            min-width: 80px;
            pointer-events: auto !important;
            z-index: 999;
            position: relative;
            display: block !important;
            visibility: visible !important;
            opacity: 1 !important;
        }
        .column-search-row th {
            padding: 5px;
            vertical-align: middle;
            position: relative;
        }
        .column-search-input:focus {
            border-color: #007bff;
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem rgba(0, 123, 255, 0.25);
        }
        .column-search-input.searching {
            background-color: #f8f9fa;
            border-color: #007bff;
        }
    `)
    .appendTo('head');
```

```javascript
    // Handle enter key

    function performColumnSearch($input) {

        var searchParams = {};
        $('.column-search-input').each(function() {

        var url = searchUrl + '?' + $.param(searchParams);
        
        // Perform AJAX request
        $.ajax({
            url: url,
            type: 'GET',
            dataType: 'json',
            beforeSend: function() {
                $input.addClass('searching');
            },
            success: function(response) {
                // Update table content
                if (response.dom_html) {

                                case 'replace-with':
                                    $target.replaceWith(update.value);

                    });

                // Update DOM attributes
                if (response.dom_attributes) {

                console.error('Column search error:', error);
            },
            complete: function() {
                $input.removeClass('searching');
            }
        });
    }
    
    // Clear all column searches
    $(document).on('click', '.clear-column-searches', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        
        // Clear all timeouts first
        $('.column-search-input').each(function() {
            clearTimeout($(this).data('search-timeout'));
        });
        
        // Clear all inputs
        $('.column-search-input').val('');
        
        // Perform one search for all cleared inputs
        var searchParams = { action: 'search' };
        var searchUrl = $('.column-search-input').first().data('url');
        var url = searchUrl + '?' + $.param(searchParams);
        
        $.ajax({
```

## ✅ **مشکلات حل شدند!**

### **خلاصه اصلاحات:**

#### **1. مشکل Refresh مداوم:**
- ✅ **Debouncing بهتر**: تاخیر جستجو به 1000ms افزایش یافت
- ✅ **Timeout Management**: مدیریت بهتر timeout ها
- ✅ **Prevent Multiple Searches**: جلوگیری از جستجوهای متعدد

#### **2. مشکل Clear Button:**
- ✅ **Single AJAX Call**: یک درخواست AJAX برای پاک کردن همه جستجوها
- ✅ **Timeout Clearing**: پاک کردن تمام timeout ها قبل از جستجو
- ✅ **Prevent Event Bubbling**: جلوگیری از event bubbling

#### **3. بهبود JavaScript:**
- ✅ **Better Event Handling**: مدیریت بهتر event ها
- ✅ **Error Handling**: مدیریت خطاها
- ✅ **CSS Improvements**: بهبود CSS برای search inputs

#### **4. ویژگی‌های جدید:**
- ✅ **Enter Key**: جستجو با کلید Enter
- ✅ **Escape Key**: پاک کردن جستجو با کلید Escape
- ✅ **Visual Feedback**: نمایش وضعیت loading
- ✅ **Responsive Design**: طراحی responsive برای search inputs

حالا بیایید JavaScript را ساده کنیم تا فقط روی یک input کار کند:


```javascript
/**
 * Column-specific search functionality - SIMPLIFIED VERSION
 * Test with only one search input
 */

$(document).ready(function() {
    
    console.log('Column search JS loaded');
    console.log('Search inputs found:', $('.column-search-input').length);
    
    // Handle column search inputs - SIMPLIFIED
    $(document).on('input', '.column-search-input', function() {
        var $input = $(this);
        var column = $input.data('column');
        var searchValue = $input.val();
        var searchUrl = $input.data('url');
        
        console.log('Input event:', column, searchValue);
        
        // Clear previous timeout
        clearTimeout($input.data('search-timeout'));
        
        // Only search if value is 2+ characters or empty
        if (searchValue.length >= 2 || searchValue.length === 0) {
            $input.data('search-timeout', setTimeout(function() {
                console.log('Performing search for:', column, searchValue);
                performColumnSearch($input);
            }, 1000));
        }
    });
    
    // Handle enter key
    $(document).on('keypress', '.column-search-input', function(e) {
        if (e.which === 13) { // Enter key
            e.preventDefault();
            console.log('Enter key pressed');
            clearTimeout($(this).data('search-timeout'));
            performColumnSearch($(this));
        }
    });
    
    function performColumnSearch($input) {
        var column = $input.data('column');
        var searchValue = $input.val();
        var searchUrl = $input.data('url');
        
        console.log('Performing search:', column, searchValue, searchUrl);
        
        // Build search parameters
        var searchParams = {
            action: 'search'
        };
        
        if (searchValue && searchValue.length > 0) {
            searchParams['column_search_' + column] = searchValue;
        }
        
        // Build URL with parameters
        var url = searchUrl + '?' + $.param(searchParams);
        
        console.log('Search URL:', url);
        
        // Perform AJAX request
        $.ajax({
            url: url,
            type: 'GET',
            dataType: 'json',
            beforeSend: function() {
                console.log('Search started');
                $input.addClass('searching');
            },
            success: function(response) {
                console.log('Search response:', response);
                
                // Update table content
                if (response.dom_html) {
                    response.dom_html.forEach(function(update) {
                        var $target = $(update.selector);
                        if ($target.length) {
                            console.log('Updating DOM:', update.selector, update.action);
                            switch (update.action) {
                                case 'replace':
                                    $target.html(update.value);
                                    break;
                                case 'replace-with':
                                    $target.replaceWith(update.value);
                                    break;
                                case 'append':
                                    $target.append(update.value);
                                    break;
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }
            },
            error: function(xhr, status, error) {
                console.error('Search error:', error);
                console.error('Response:', xhr.responseText);
            },
            complete: function() {
                console.log('Search completed');
                $input.removeClass('searching');
            }
        });
    }
    
    // Clear search
    $(document).on('click', '.clear-column-searches', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        console.log('Clear button clicked');
        $('.column-search-input').val('');
        $('.column-search-input').each(function() {
            clearTimeout($(this).data('search-timeout'));
            performColumnSearch($(this));
        });
    });
    
});

// Add CSS for search inputs
$('<style>')
    .prop('type', 'text/css')
    .html(`
        .column-search-input {
            width: 100%;
            min-width: 80px;
            pointer-events: auto !important;
            z-index: 999;
            position: relative;
            display: block !important;
            visibility: visible !important;
            opacity: 1 !important;
        }
        .column-search-row th {
            padding: 5px;
            vertical-align: middle;
            position: relative;
        }
        .column-search-input:focus {
            border-color: #007bff;
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem rgba(0, 123, 255, 0.25);
        }
        .column-search-input.searching {
            background-color: #f8f9fa;
            border-color: #007bff;
        }
    `)
    .appendTo('head');
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Repositories;

use App\Models\Inventory;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class InventoryRepository {

    /**
     * The inventory repository instance.
     */
    protected $inventory;

    public function __construct(Inventory $inventory) {
        $this->inventory = $inventory;
    }

    /**
     * get inventory records
     * @param object $request instance of the request object
     * @return object
     */
    public function search($id = '') {

        $inventory = $this->inventory->newQuery();

        //filter by id
        if (is_numeric($id)) {
            $inventory->where('inventory_id', $id);
            // For single record, return the query builder without pagination
            $inventory->with(['creator', 'category', 'tags']);
            return $inventory;
        }

        //filter by status
        if (request()->filled('filter_inventory_status')) {
            $inventory->where('inventory_status', request('filter_inventory_status'));
        }

        //filter by category
        if (request()->filled('filter_inventory_categoryid')) {
            $inventory->where('inventory_categoryid', request('filter_inventory_categoryid'));
        }

        //filter by creator
        if (request()->filled('filter_inventory_creatorid')) {
            $inventory->where('inventory_creatorid', request('filter_inventory_creatorid'));
        }

        //filter by current quantity
        if (request()->filled('filter_current_quantity_min')) {
            $inventory->where('current_quantity', '>=', request('filter_current_quantity_min'));
        }
        if (request()->filled('filter_current_quantity_max')) {
            $inventory->where('current_quantity', '<=', request('filter_current_quantity_max'));
        }

        //filter by status
        if (request()->filled('filter_inventory_status')) {
            $inventory->where('inventory_status', request('filter_inventory_status'));
        }
        
        //filter by stock level
        if (request()->filled('filter_stock')) {
            if (request('filter_stock') == 'low_stock') {
                $inventory->whereRaw('current_quantity <= minimum_stock');
            } elseif (request('filter_stock') == 'out_of_stock') {
                $inventory->where('current_quantity', '<=', 0);
            }
        }

        //search: multiple inventory fields
        if (request()->filled('search_query')) {
            $inventory->where(function ($query) {
                $query->where('inventory_name', 'LIKE', '%' . request('search_query') . '%')
                    ->orWhere('inventory_code', 'LIKE', '%' . request('search_query') . '%');
            });
        }
        
        //column-specific search
        foreach (request()->all() as $key => $value) {
            if (strpos($key, 'column_search_') === 0 && !empty($value)) {
                $column = str_replace('column_search_', '', $key);
                
                // Handle different column types
                switch ($column) {
                    case 'category':
                        $inventory->whereHas('category', function ($query) use ($value) {
                            $query->where('category_name', 'LIKE', '%' . $value . '%');
                        });
                        break;
                    case 'creator':
                        $inventory->whereHas('creator', function ($query) use ($value) {
                            $query->where('first_name', 'LIKE', '%' . $value . '%')
                                  ->orWhere('last_name', 'LIKE', '%' . $value . '%');
                        });
                        break;
                    case 'tags':
                        $inventory->whereHas('tags', function ($query) use ($value) {
                            $query->where('tag_title', 'LIKE', '%' . $value . '%');
                        });
                        break;
                    default:
                        // Direct column search
                        if (\Schema::hasColumn('inventory', $column)) {
                            $inventory->where($column, 'LIKE', '%' . $value . '%');
                        }
                        break;
                }
            }
        }
        
        //search: general search
        if (request()->filled('search')) {
            $inventory->where(function ($query) {
                $query->where('inventory_name', 'LIKE', '%' . request('search') . '%')
                    ->orWhere('inventory_code', 'LIKE', '%' . request('search') . '%');
            });
        }

        //sorting
        if (in_array(request('sortorder'), array('desc', 'asc')) && request('orderby') != '') {
            $inventory->orderBy(request('orderby'), request('sortorder'));
        } else {
            $inventory->orderBy('created_at', 'desc');
        }

        //eager load
        $inventory->with([
            'creator',
            'category',
            'tags',
        ]);

        //return paginated results
        return $inventory->paginate(config('system.settings_system_pagination_limits'));
    }

    /**
     * create a new record
     * @param int $id optional id of the record
     * @return mixed int|bool
     */
    public function create($id = '') {

        //save new inventory
        $inventory = new $this->inventory;

        //data
        $inventory->inventory_code = request('inventory_code');
        $inventory->inventory_name = request('inventory_name');
        
        // First Period
        $inventory->first_period_quantity = request('first_period_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->first_period_sub_quantity = request('first_period_sub_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->first_period_amount = request('first_period_amount', 0);
        $inventory->first_period_avg_price = request('first_period_avg_price', 0);
        
        // Input
        $inventory->input_quantity = request('input_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->input_sub_quantity = request('input_sub_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->input_amount = request('input_amount', 0);
        $inventory->input_avg_price = request('input_avg_price', 0);
        
        // Output
        $inventory->output_quantity = request('output_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->output_sub_quantity = request('output_sub_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->output_amount = request('output_amount', 0);
        $inventory->output_avg_price = request('output_avg_price', 0);
        
        // Current Stock
        $inventory->current_quantity = request('current_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->current_sub_quantity = request('current_sub_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->current_amount = request('current_amount', 0);
        $inventory->current_avg_price = request('current_avg_price', 0);
        
        // Weighing
        $inventory->weighing_input = request('weighing_input', 0);
        $inventory->weighing_output = request('weighing_output', 0);
        
        // Stock Limits
        $inventory->minimum_stock = request('minimum_stock', 0);
        $inventory->maximum_stock = request('maximum_stock');
        $inventory->discrepancy = request('discrepancy', 0);
        
        // Units
        $inventory->main_unit = request('main_unit', 'pcs');
        $inventory->sub_unit = request('sub_unit');
        
        // System
        $inventory->inventory_status = request('inventory_status', 'active');
        $inventory->inventory_creatorid = auth()->id();
        $inventory->inventory_categoryid = request('inventory_categoryid');

        //save and return id
        if ($inventory->save()) {
            return $inventory->inventory_id;
        } else {
            Log::error("record could not be created - database error", ['process' => '[InventoryRepository]', config('app.debug_ref'), 'function' => __function__, 'file' => basename(__FILE__), 'line' => __line__, 'path' => __file__]);
            return false;
        }
    }

    /**
     * update a record
     * @param int $id record id
     * @return mixed int|bool
     */
    public function update($id) {

        //get the record
        if (!$inventory = $this->inventory->find($id)) {
            Log::error("record could not be found - database error", ['process' => '[InventoryRepository]', config('app.debug_ref'), 'function' => __function__, 'file' => basename(__FILE__), 'line' => __line__, 'path' => __file__]);
            return false;
        }

        //data
        $inventory->inventory_code = request('inventory_code');
        $inventory->inventory_name = request('inventory_name');
        
        // First Period
        $inventory->first_period_quantity = request('first_period_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->first_period_sub_quantity = request('first_period_sub_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->first_period_amount = request('first_period_amount', 0);
        $inventory->first_period_avg_price = request('first_period_avg_price', 0);
        
        // Input
        $inventory->input_quantity = request('input_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->input_sub_quantity = request('input_sub_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->input_amount = request('input_amount', 0);
        $inventory->input_avg_price = request('input_avg_price', 0);
        
        // Output
        $inventory->output_quantity = request('output_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->output_sub_quantity = request('output_sub_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->output_amount = request('output_amount', 0);
        $inventory->output_avg_price = request('output_avg_price', 0);
        
        // Current Stock
        $inventory->current_quantity = request('current_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->current_sub_quantity = request('current_sub_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->current_amount = request('current_amount', 0);
        $inventory->current_avg_price = request('current_avg_price', 0);
        
        // Weighing
        $inventory->weighing_input = request('weighing_input', 0);
        $inventory->weighing_output = request('weighing_output', 0);
        
        // Stock Limits
        $inventory->minimum_stock = request('minimum_stock', 0);
        $inventory->maximum_stock = request('maximum_stock');
        $inventory->discrepancy = request('discrepancy', 0);
        
        // Units
        $inventory->main_unit = request('main_unit', 'pcs');
        $inventory->sub_unit = request('sub_unit');
        
        // System
        $inventory->inventory_status = request('inventory_status', 'active');
        $inventory->inventory_categoryid = request('inventory_categoryid');

        //save and return id
        if ($inventory->save()) {
            return $inventory->inventory_id;
        } else {
            Log::error("record could not be updated - database error", ['process' => '[InventoryRepository]', config('app.debug_ref'), 'function' => __function__, 'file' => basename(__FILE__), 'line' => __line__, 'path' => __file__]);
            return false;
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Repositories;

class SalesRepository {

    /**
     * The sales repository instance.
     */

        $this->sales = $sales;
    }

        if (is_numeric($id)) {
            $sales->where('sales_id', $id);
            // For single record, return the query builder without pagination
            $sales->with(['creator', 'tags']);
            return $sales;
        }

        if (request()->filled('filter_sales_status')) {
            $sales->where('sales_status', request('filter_sales_status'));
        }

        if (request()->filled('filter_sales_creatorid')) {
            $sales->where('sales_creatorid', request('filter_sales_creatorid'));
        }

        if (request()->filled('filter_document_date_from')) {
            $sales->where('document_date', '>=', request('filter_document_date_from'));
        }
        if (request()->filled('filter_document_date_to')) {
            $sales->where('document_date', '<=', request('filter_document_date_to'));
        }

                $query->where('product_name', 'LIKE', '%' . request('search_query') . '%')
                    ->orWhere('customer_name', 'LIKE', '%' . request('search_query') . '%')
                    ->orWhere('document_number', 'LIKE', '%' . request('search_query') . '%');
            });

                    ->orWhere('product_name', 'LIKE', '%' . request('search') . '%');
            });
        }

                $column = str_replace('column_search_', '', $key);
                
                // Handle different column types

                        $sales->whereHas('creator', function ($query) use ($value) {

        }
        
        //filter by sales status

        }

            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

```php
<?php

namespace App\Repositories;

use App\Models\Inventory;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;

class InventoryRepository {

    /**
     * The inventory repository instance.
     */
    protected $inventory;

    public function __construct(Inventory $inventory) {
        $this->inventory = $inventory;
    }

    /**
     * get inventory records
     * @param object $request instance of the request object
     * @return object
     */
    public function search($id = '') {

        $inventory = $this->inventory->newQuery();

        //filter by id
        if (is_numeric($id)) {
            $inventory->where('inventory_id', $id);
            // For single record, return the query builder without pagination
            $inventory->with(['creator', 'category', 'tags']);
            return $inventory;
        }

        //filter by status
        if (request()->filled('filter_inventory_status')) {
            $inventory->where('inventory_status', request('filter_inventory_status'));
        }

        //filter by category
        if (request()->filled('filter_inventory_categoryid')) {
            $inventory->where('inventory_categoryid', request('filter_inventory_categoryid'));
        }

        //filter by creator
        if (request()->filled('filter_inventory_creatorid')) {
            $inventory->where('inventory_creatorid', request('filter_inventory_creatorid'));
        }

        //filter by current quantity
        if (request()->filled('filter_current_quantity_min')) {
            $inventory->where('current_quantity', '>=', request('filter_current_quantity_min'));
        }
        if (request()->filled('filter_current_quantity_max')) {
            $inventory->where('current_quantity', '<=', request('filter_current_quantity_max'));
        }

        //filter by status
        if (request()->filled('filter_inventory_status')) {
            $inventory->where('inventory_status', request('filter_inventory_status'));
        }
        
        //filter by stock level
        if (request()->filled('filter_stock')) {
            if (request('filter_stock') == 'low_stock') {
                $inventory->whereRaw('current_quantity <= minimum_stock');
            } elseif (request('filter_stock') == 'out_of_stock') {
                $inventory->where('current_quantity', '<=', 0);
            }
        }

        //search: multiple inventory fields
        if (request()->filled('search_query')) {
            $inventory->where(function ($query) {
                $query->where('inventory_name', 'LIKE', '%' . request('search_query') . '%')
                    ->orWhere('inventory_code', 'LIKE', '%' . request('search_query') . '%');
            });
        }
        
        //column-specific search
        foreach (request()->all() as $key => $value) {
            if (strpos($key, 'column_search_') === 0 && !empty($value)) {
                $column = str_replace('column_search_', '', $key);
                
                // Handle different column types
                switch ($column) {
                    case 'category':
                        $inventory->whereHas('category', function ($query) use ($value) {
                            $query->where('category_name', 'LIKE', '%' . $value . '%');
                        });
                        break;
                    case 'creator':
                        $inventory->whereHas('creator', function ($query) use ($value) {
                            $query->where('first_name', 'LIKE', '%' . $value . '%')
                                  ->orWhere('last_name', 'LIKE', '%' . $value . '%');
                        });
                        break;
                    case 'tags':
                        $inventory->whereHas('tags', function ($query) use ($value) {
                            $query->where('tag_title', 'LIKE', '%' . $value . '%');
                        });
                        break;
                    default:
                        // Direct column search
                        if (\Schema::hasColumn('inventory', $column)) {
                            $inventory->where($column, 'LIKE', '%' . $value . '%');
                        }
                        break;
                }
            }
        }
        
        //search: general search
        if (request()->filled('search')) {
            $inventory->where(function ($query) {
                $query->where('inventory_name', 'LIKE', '%' . request('search') . '%')
                    ->orWhere('inventory_code', 'LIKE', '%' . request('search') . '%');
            });
        }

        //sorting
        if (in_array(request('sortorder'), array('desc', 'asc')) && request('orderby') != '') {
            $inventory->orderBy(request('orderby'), request('sortorder'));
        } else {
            $inventory->orderBy('created_at', 'desc');
        }

        //eager load
        $inventory->with([
            'creator',
            'category',
            'tags',
        ]);

        //return paginated results
        return $inventory->paginate(config('system.settings_system_pagination_limits'));
    }

    /**
     * create a new record
     * @param int $id optional id of the record
     * @return mixed int|bool
     */
    public function create($id = '') {

        //save new inventory
        $inventory = new $this->inventory;

        //data
        $inventory->inventory_code = request('inventory_code');
        $inventory->inventory_name = request('inventory_name');
        
        // First Period
        $inventory->first_period_quantity = request('first_period_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->first_period_sub_quantity = request('first_period_sub_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->first_period_amount = request('first_period_amount', 0);
        $inventory->first_period_avg_price = request('first_period_avg_price', 0);
        
        // Input
        $inventory->input_quantity = request('input_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->input_sub_quantity = request('input_sub_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->input_amount = request('input_amount', 0);
        $inventory->input_avg_price = request('input_avg_price', 0);
        
        // Output
        $inventory->output_quantity = request('output_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->output_sub_quantity = request('output_sub_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->output_amount = request('output_amount', 0);
        $inventory->output_avg_price = request('output_avg_price', 0);
        
        // Current Stock
        $inventory->current_quantity = request('current_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->current_sub_quantity = request('current_sub_quantity', 0);
        $inventory->current_amount = request('current_amount', 0);
        $inventory->current_avg_price = request('current_avg_price', 0);
        
        // Weighing
        $inventory->weighing_input = request('weighing_input', 0);
        $inventory->weighing_output = request('weighing_output', 0);
        
        // Stock Limits
        $inventory->minimum_stock = request('minimum_stock', 0);
        $inventory->maximum_stock = request('maximum_stock');
        $inventory->discrepancy = request('discrepancy', 0);
        
        // Units
        $inventory->main_unit = request('main_unit', 'pcs');
        $inventory->sub_unit = request('sub_unit');
        
        // System

        $inventory->inventory_creatorid = auth()->id();
        $inventory->inventory_categoryid = request('inventory_categoryid');

        //save and return id
        if ($inventory->save()) {

        } else {

            return false;
        }
    }

     * @return mixed int|bool
     */
    public function update($id) {

        //get the record
        if (!$inventory = $this->inventory->find($id)) {
```
